umi.method: PSCI SMC64 CPU_ON, Affinity1 IDs, standard SGI0 via ICC_SGI1R_EL1, self-IPI enabled, SPI fallback disabled; clean reset vector/data/boot_args before wake
umi.limitation: Other-device evidence; does not qualify T970 SMP. Public validation records Hello/Setup, not completed home screen; CPU presentation is not GPU acceleration.

t733.method: cpus=8/sheng-smp=1 and custom armcpu-redist-ipi=1; GICR_ISPENDR0 SGI pending writes
t733.limitation: Custom fork also changes counters and startup evidence; its switch is not implemented by current T970 catalog ArmCpu and is not adopted.

reset_translation_publication.review_correction: Initial review focused on SGI/entry counters and missed these two extra clean ranges; full fork comparison now confirms direct precedent.

t970.selected_method: Use existing PSCI/cache-clean/standard-SGI implementation, then staged2->8 hardware qualification. Do not change default CPU0 DTS or adopt T733 registers.
t970.cpu_rendering_distinction: Core count may help software rendering. CPU framebuffer copy/display publication still needs separate backend/ABI/handoff integration.
